beats.html:
The worst of them ran through
the 1500s and 1600s.

The same years as the
printing press and the
beginnings of modern science.

Progress and panic were not
separate eras. They ran side
by side, in the same rooms.

clip.match_reason: The turn of the fact is that the printing press and the witch trials ran in the same years, and the plate is a working 16th century press room with the sheets already stacked and the candles still lit.
